about: A JavaScript tool that finds problems in code and rewrites it automatically using plugins.

prs.title: Exported variables are left alone
prs.broken: A rule that joins a variable with its first assignment also rewrote exported variables, which can break modules that depend on that export.
prs.matters: Running the fixer does not change what a module exports.

prs.title: Number separators no longer break binary numbers
prs.broken: The rule that adds underscores to long numbers also touched binary and uppercase hex or octal numbers, putting separators in places that changed or broke the code.
prs.changed: The rule now skips those prefixed numbers.
prs.matters: Running the fixer never turns working number literals into errors.
